LanguageData.DMS_Apparel_PackHound.label: hound drone pack
LanguageData.DMS_Apparel_PackHound.description: A large pack for carrying and deploying hound drones in combat, which also serves as a remote base station to command and recover the drones.
LanguageData.DMS_Apparel_PackVerling.label: Verling bird drone belt
LanguageData.DMS_Apparel_PackVerling.description: A remote controller and assembly module for carrying and deploying Verling bird drones in combat, which also serves as a remote base station to command and recover the drones.
LanguageData.DMS_Apparel_PackScanner.label: scanner pack
LanguageData.DMS_Apparel_PackScanner.description: A wearable pack that allows the user to deploy a battery-powered perimeter scanner. The pack contains a propulsion device, letting the user launch the scanner a short distance. The scanner battery lasts for several hours.
LanguageData.DMS_Grenade_ScannerPack.label: scanner pack capsule
